upstream.description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that bridges Video & Audio content with Large Language Models using yt-dlp.

classification.analysis: yt-dlp-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server that wraps yt-dlp to give LLMs (Claude, Dive, Cursor, etc.) tools for searching YouTube, extracting video/channel metadata, downloading subtitles/transcripts, downloading video/audio, and pulling flat or threaded comments in JSON or Markdown. It targets developers wanting natural-language video-platform access from any MCP-compatible AI client, with configurable proxy/cookie support via env vars or the yt-dlp config file, and includes a bundled Claude Code MCP-builder skill. A TypeScript/Node package published to npm, actively maintained with a broad test suite.

use_cases.title: Let an LLM search and summarize YouTube videos
Pull clean transcripts or subtitles for an agent to read
Download video/audio from a natural-language request
Fetch threaded YouTube comments for sentiment analysis
